name: Granite 4.2 8B
notes: Read from config.json on 2026-08-25: GraniteForCausalLM, 40 layers, hidden 4096, vocab 100,352, max_position_embeddings 131,072, bfloat16. Dense — no MoE fields in the config — so active_params_b equals params_b. params_b is measured from the Hugging Face safetensors index (8,791,592,960 parameters), not estimated from the name: the repository is published as 'granite-4.2-8b' while the checkpoint holds 8.79B. The card advertises reasoning and tool calling; whether thinking is on by default is a property of the chat template and belongs in each run's provenance rather than here.
